about: Jeffrey B. Coopersmith is an attorney providing legal services covering Criminal Defense: White Collar, Health Care and Securities Litigation.

Jeffrey Coopersmith, who practices law in Seattle, Washington, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2010 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at Emory University School of Law. He graduated in 1990. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1990.
